Live casino bonuses
Live casino bonuses are offers you can use exclusively on live dealer games. They often come as bonus money, free live casino chips or cashback. If you're into live dealer action, browse the list of the top live casino bonuses.

Cashback bonuses
Cashback bonuses are casinos' way to reward existing players by giving a slice of their net losses back, often on a weekly basis. If this type of casino bonus is your thing, click the button for the best cashback bonuses in Canada.

Bonus Offers For Small Deposits
If you've gone through the no-deposit bonuses, your next step would be looking at deposit bonuses. Regular deposit bonuses require a deposit between $10 and $30, but there are casinos that boost your account with less:
- $1 deposit bonus: Find casinos in Canada that give out bonuses for just 1 dollar.
- $2 deposit bonuses: It may surprise you how much you can get for a $2 deposit.
- $3 deposit casinos: Get a casino bonus for the price of a coffee cup.
Responsible Gambling
No deposit casino bonuses are a great way to try real money online casinos without spending a dime. Before you make your first deposit, it's worth taking a moment to set clear limits for yourself so that gambling stays fun and enjoyable.
Most licensed casinos operating in Canada offer a range of responsible gambling tools. These tools let you set limits on how much money you can deposit each week or month, for example. Many casinos also provide reality checks that remind you how long you've been playing, such as after an hour of gameplay. Sticking to the limits you've set helps you stay in control and look after both your finances and your well-being.
If you feel like it's getting out of hand or starts causing harm, I suggest checking out our responsible gambling guide for helpful information, taking a cooling-off period or self-excluding yourself from the casino. Additionally, here are some contact details for various organizations in Canada:
